title: ClassPass vs Gym Membership in NZ — Which Saves More Money?
meta_desc: ClassPass vs gym membership in NZ: compare prices and save money
intro: With ClassPass credits starting from $49 per month for 3 credits, Kiwis are considering alternative fitness options to traditional gym memberships. For example, a monthly membership at Les Mills Auckland costs around $34.95 per week. However, the real question is: which option provides better value for money?

sections.heading: How ClassPass Works in NZ
sections.body: ClassPass is a fitness membership platform that allows users to attend various classes and workouts at different studios and gyms across NZ. The platform operates on a credit system, where users purchase credits that can be redeemed for classes. The number of credits required per class varies, with most classes costing between 2-4 credits.

sections.heading: Dedicated Gym Membership Prices in NZ
Price Comparison: ClassPass vs Dedicated Membership
sections.body: To make a fair comparison, let's consider the cost of attending 4 classes per week. With ClassPass, this would require the 10-credit plan, costing $139 per month. In contrast, a dedicated membership at Les Mills Auckland costs $149.95 per month, but includes unlimited access to classes and facilities. However, if you prefer a more flexible schedule, ClassPass might be the better option.

sections.heading: Best Use Cases for ClassPass and Dedicated Memberships
list: Use ClassPass for: trying out new workouts, accessing boutique studios, and flexibility in scheduling
Use dedicated membership for: frequent gym-goers, those who prefer a fixed routine, and access to additional facilities like pools and saunas

sections.heading: Popular Gyms in NZ
sections.body: For those interested in exploring dedicated gym memberships, popular options in NZ include Les Mills, Jetts, and Anytime Fitness. You can visit our gym pages for more information and to compare prices: /gym/les-mills, /gym/jetts, /gym/anytime-fitness
